name: Des Moines Parks and Recreation Lifeguard Class and Seasonal Jobs
org: City of Des Moines Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take the American Red Cross lifeguard class. Then apply for lifeguard jobs at city pools. One is the Prairie Meadows Pool at Reichardt Community Recreation Center.
who_can_apply: The lifeguard class is for ages 15 and up. The page does not state an age rule for the jobs themselves. Call the department to ask about camp staff and other seasonal jobs.
pay_detail: Paid jobs. Pay is not listed on the program pages. The lifeguard class costs $200, and the city refunds the $200 if you accept a job offer with the department.
duration: Lifeguard jobs at the indoor pool are year-round. The class meets Friday to Sunday.
deadline_text: Lifeguard job applications are open now with no closing date posted. The next lifeguard class on the page is Dec 4 to 6, with limited spots.
how_to_apply: Register for the lifeguard class with the Register Here link on the city Aquatics page. Apply for jobs through the Park Jobs link on the same page. Questions: parks@dmgov.org or (515) 237-1386.
notes: The Dec 4 to 6 class date is shown without a year on the program page. Iowa work paper rules for teens were not checked. Summer camp staff jobs may have a higher age limit, so confirm before you apply.
